## Command: `get_force_field_opt_geo_files`

<div class="analysis-section-indent" markdown="1">

Split a force-field optimization GEO file into one folder per DESCRP identifier.
Each folder contains <identifier>.geo and <identifier>.xyz.

### Examples
-----

```text
  reaxkit get_force_field_opt_geo_files --geo geo
  reaxkit get_force_field_opt_geo_files --geo geo --identifier bulk_e3_mp_2604
  reaxkit get_force_field_opt_geo_files --geo geo --output extracted --overwrite
```
